name: meta/llama-3.3-70b-instruct
description: Llama 3.3 70B Instruct is Meta's instruction-tuned, text-only multilingual model released on December 6, 2024, built on an optimized transformer with grouped-query attention and a 128K-token context. It is optimized for assistant-style multilingual dialogue in eight officially supported languages, including English, German, French, Spanish, Hindi and Thai. It is a static open-weight model with a December 2023 knowledge cutoff, and its license also permits synthetic data generation and distillation.
